title: Help With the Track
can_do: 遇到具体困难时，请求恰好够用的帮助，同时保留自己完成任务的机会。
trigger: The ring of train track is missing its final curve piece, so Child asks Dad for help and they split the job between them.
setting: Connecting a toy train track at a low table.
essential_props: a toy train track ring with one loose curve piece and one train

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Your train track looks long today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: One piece won't fit. Can you help me, please?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The curvy one. Its ends won't click together.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I'll hold the track. You push the curve in.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It clicked! Now the track goes all the way around.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: All joined. Try your train now.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Here comes the train! Thank you, Dad.

replay_cards.title: Open the lunch box
replay_cards.change: The box slides when Child tries to lift its latch
replay_cards.challenge: Child says, 'Can you help me hold the box?' Dad asks where to hold it. Child points to the side away from the latch. Dad steadies that side, Child lifts the latch and opens the lid, then confirms it is open.

replay_cards.title: Zip the coat
replay_cards.change: The zipper has been started but its bottom lifts when Child pulls
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks Mom for help and points to the bottom of the zipper. Mom holds the joined base steady while Child pulls the zipper up. Child checks that the coat is closed, and they go outside together.

parent_support: Let him show the join that will not connect; ask which piece needs support if his first request is unclear.
Hold only the side he identifies and let him do the connecting. The useful sequence is adult support first, then his own action.
Once the ring closes, let him test it with the train himself. A brief puzzled look is enough; help is ordinary and does not require visible distress.
